title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
lede: Several tech leaders, Elon Musk the loudest, welcomed Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO, while Republican senators said the national security questions around him remain open.

points: Huang returned as CEO and president on Monday despite three affairs, one with an alleged Chinese spy that prompted congressional investigations.
Musk posted that the mistake had been corrected; Changpeng Zhao, Tim Sweeney and Travis Kalanick also voiced support.
Sam Altman, once ousted and reinstated at OpenAI himself, stayed neutral and posted only Huang's first name.
Bill Ackman credited Nvidia's Monday rebound to the wisdom of the crowd.
Senators John Cornyn and Pete Ricketts questioned President Trump's no-risk claim; Huang is due before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3.
